summary.text: Michael Bahry is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate. A Rhode Island native, he worked as a laborer, carpenter and construction executive and founded a Providence nonprofit before returning to school for two master's degrees in theology and biblical studies. He is running on ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars and on congressional term limits.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, a native Rhode Islander, married for over 40 years, with two children and four grandchildren.
His career spanned roles as a laborer, carpenter, construction executive and business owner, including running a commercial construction company.
Founded the nonprofit Fifty-Three: Five in 2014, which provides food, fellowship and support to families and the homeless in Providence, and speaks monthly at the Providence Rescue Mission.
At age 53 returned to college, earning a Master of Theological Studies (2017) and a Master of Arts in Biblical Studies (2022) from Providence College.

Teaches theology at Salve Regina University and is the author of the book Hell Is a Bad Word, according to his campaign website. He is a lector and finance committee member at Our Lady of Loreto Church.
